name: 3D Rigging
description: Rig an existing 3D model URL with a skeleton, optionally applying a pre-canned animation

parameters.name: model_url
parameters.description: Public HTTPS URL without embedded credentials of an existing 3D model (GLB) to rig. Pass the output URL of a previous 3D generation (e.g. from image_to_3d, multi_image_to_3d, sam_3_3d), the url media_upload returned for an uploaded .glb (never its upload_url), or a publicly-hosted GLB.

parameters.name: height_meters
parameters.description: Approximate real-world height of the rigged figure in meters (default 1.7). Used to scale the skeleton.

parameters.name: enable_animation
parameters.description: Apply a pre-canned animation clip to the rigged model. Pick the clip via animation_action_id.

parameters.name: animation_action_id
parameters.description: Animation clip id (integer, 0-696) for the rig. Required when enable_animation=true. Common picks - idle: 0; walk: 30 (Casual_Walk); run: 16 (RunFast); jump: 466 (Regular_Jump); wave: 28 (Big_Wave_Hello); dance: 64 (All_Night_Dance). For anything else, call the animation_actions tool to search the full 678-action library by name or category.

parameters.name: enable_safety_checker
parameters.description: Run NSFW safety check on output.
